headline:
Explosive growth,
PEG still under 1
chart_note: 10-day range: $208.48 - $227.98, roughly flat over the window - still comfortably above both the 50-day ($208.62) and 200-day ($195.96) averages.
why_today: Down 1.5% today but still trading well above both moving averages - the past quarter's growth remains extraordinary.
pro_1: Revenue up 106% and earnings up 128% YoY - among the fastest-growing large companies anywhere
pro_2: PEG ratio of 0.63 is unusually low for this growth rate, and analyst sentiment is close to unanimous (58 of 61 Buy/Strong Buy)
con_1: Beta and daily swings remain high - this is not a low-volatility holding, even with strong fundamentals
con_2: 63.7% profit margin and 106% revenue growth are extraordinary - worth watching whether that pace is sustainable
